4:66.text: And if We had decreed upon them, "Kill yourselves" or "Leave your homes," they would not have done it, except for a few of them. But if they had done what they were instructed, it would have been better for them and a firmer position

4:67.text: And then We would have given them from Us a great reward.

4:68.text: And We would have guided them to a straight path.

4:69.text: And whoever obeys Allāh and the Messenger - those will be with the ones upon whom Allāh has bestowed favor of the prophets, the steadfast affirmers of truth, the martyrs and the righteous. And excellent are those as companions.

4:70.text: That is the bounty from Allāh, and sufficient is Allāh as Knower.

4:71.text: O you who have believed, take your precaution and
go forth in companies or go forth all together.

4:72.text: And indeed, there is among you he who lingers behind; and if disaster strikes you, he says, "Allāh has favored me in that I was not present with them."

4:73.text: But if bounty comes to you from Allāh, he will surely say, as if
there had never been between you and him any affection, "Oh, I wish I had been with them so I could have attained a great attainment."

4:74.text: So let those fight in the cause of Allāh who sell the life of this world for the Hereafter. And he who fights in the cause of Allāh and is killed or achieves victory - We will bestow upon him a great reward.
